meta.title: Privacy Policy | ONDA Life
meta.description: ONDA Life Privacy Policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use the ONDA mobile application.

html:
This Privacy Policy describes how the ONDA mobile application (hereinafter "the App", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and discloses your information in connection with your use of our application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data responsibly.

1. Information Collection and Use

We collect various types of information to provide and improve our services and to ensure a personalized experience.

1.1. Personal Data

When using our App, we may ask you to provide certain personal information that can be used to identify or contact you. Such information may include, but is not limited to:

  • Identification Data: Email address, username (display_name), avatar URL (avatar_url).
  • Health Data: Heart rate, sleep data obtained through Apple HealthKit (for iOS) and Health Connect (for Android), as well as from connected Bluetooth heart rate monitors. This data is used for adaptive meditations, breathing exercises, and calculating stress and energy indicators.
  • Activity Data: Practice history, completed practices, game progress (earned OND, unlocked artifacts, level progression).

1.2. Usage and Analytics Data

We automatically collect information about App usage for analytical purposes to understand how users interact with the App and to improve its functionality. This data includes:

  • Device Data: Platform (iOS, Android, watchOS), app version.
  • Session Data: Session identifier, anonymous identifier (for tracking before login).
  • Interaction Events: App opening, onboarding start and completion, viewing onboarding steps, login/registration, requests and grants for health data access permissions, Apple Watch connection attempts and successes, practice start/pause/resume/complete/abandon, heart rate data reception, successful/unsuccessful biometric data synchronization, virtual currency (OND) acquisition, artifact unlocking, level progression.
  • Error Data: Error type, error message, URL (for audio loading errors), API endpoint and status (for API errors).
  • Attribution Data: UTM parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) for tracking installation sources and campaigns.

1.3. Emotion Analysis (Voice Check)

The optional Voice Check feature records a short voice sample (approximately 10 seconds) with the user's explicit consent. The recording is forwarded over HTTPS to our Supabase Edge Function, which in turn passes it to Hume AI's prosody analysis API to estimate the dominant emotion. Hume AI returns a top-emotion label and a confidence score, which the App uses to recommend an in-app breathing practice. The audio recording is not stored on our backend after the analysis result is returned; Hume AI's own retention policy applies during the analysis window.

1.4. Face Check (Camera-Based State Estimation)

The optional Face Check feature uses the device's front camera to estimate three derived wellness indicators — Calm, Focus, and Fatigue. The video stream is processed entirely on-device using Google MediaPipe Tasks Vision (FaceLandmarker), a machine-learning library bundled inside the application. No video frames, no facial landmarks, no biometric templates, and no derived face data are saved to the device, transmitted off the device, or shared with any third party. The camera feed exists only inside the in-app WebView for the ~30-second scan and is discarded immediately afterwards. The three resulting numeric scores are used solely to recommend an in-app breathing practice for the current session and are not persisted.

1.5. Website Tools (Camera & Microphone in Your Browser)

Separately from the mobile app, several tools on this website can ask your browser for access to your camera or microphone:

  • Camera (heart rate): the Bio OS demo (/bio), the Camera Heart Rate tool (/tools/camera-heart-rate) and the Breath–Heart Biofeedback tool (/tools/breath-heart-biofeedback) use the rear camera for contact photoplethysmography — you rest a fingertip over the lens and the changing colour of your skin is used to estimate your heart rate.
  • Microphone (breathing rate): the Breathing Rate tool (/tools/breathing-rate) uses the microphone to estimate your breathing rate from sound.

All of this runs entirely inside your browser, in real time. No video frames, no audio, and no derived values (such as heart rate or breathing rate) are uploaded to our servers, stored, or shared with any third party. The camera or microphone stream stays only in your device’s memory for the duration of the measurement and is discarded the moment you stop it or leave the page.

An estimated heart or breathing rate is health-related data — a special category under Article 9 of the GDPR. We process it solely on the basis of your explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a) GDPR), given through your browser’s own permission prompt, and only on your device. You can decline, and you can revoke access at any time in your browser settings, without losing access to the rest of the site. This browser-based processing is separate from the mobile app’s HealthKit / Health Connect and Face Check features described above.

1.6. Camera Pulse (In-App, Fingertip)

The optional in-app Camera Pulse feature uses the device's rear camera and flash during breathing practices. With your explicit consent — given through your device's system camera-permission prompt — you rest a fingertip over the lens, and the changing colour of your fingertip is used on-device to estimate your heart rate (contact photoplethysmography). No video frames or images are saved to the device, transmitted off the device, or shared with any third party: the camera feed exists only in your device's memory for the duration of the measurement and is discarded the moment you stop it or leave the practice. The estimated heart rate — and any wellness indicators derived from it during the session — are used only on your device: they are not written to disk, saved to Apple Health, or transmitted off the device. This feature is optional — every practice works without it, and you can decline or revoke camera access at any time in your device settings. An estimated heart rate is health-related data (a special category under Article 9 GDPR); we process it on the basis of your explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a) GDPR), on your device.

2. Purposes of Data Collection

We use the collected information for various purposes, including:

  • Providing and Supporting the App: Ensuring functionality, maintaining accounts, processing transactions.
  • Personalizing Experience: Adapting meditations and exercises based on health and activity data, providing personalized feedback.
  • Improving the App: Analyzing usage to identify trends, improve features, and fix bugs.
  • Security and Fraud Prevention: Protecting our services and users.
  • Analytics and Reporting: Understanding App effectiveness and user behavior.
  • Communicating with You: Sending notifications, updates, and responding to inquiries.

3. Information Disclosure

We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except as described in this Privacy Policy.

3.1. Service Providers

We may engage third-party companies and individuals to facilitate the operation of our App ("Service Providers"), to provide services on our behalf, to perform App-related services, or to assist us in analyzing how our App is used. These third parties have access to your personal information only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.

  • Supabase: Used for user authentication, data storage (PostgreSQL), practice audio file storage, and Edge Functions execution (including emotion analysis).
  • Hume AI: Receives short voice recordings from the Voice Check feature (via our Supabase Edge Function) for emotion-prosody analysis. The recording is not retained on our backend after the analysis. See Hume AI's own privacy policy at https://hume.ai/privacy-policy.
  • Apple HealthKit / Health Connect: For collecting and synchronizing health data from your device.

3.2. Legal Compliance

We may disclose your personal information if required by law or in response to valid requests from public authorities (e.g., a court or government agency).

3.3. Business Transfer

In the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your personal information may be transferred. We will notify you before your personal information is transferred and becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.

4. Data Security

The security of your data is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

5. Data Retention

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes set forth in this Privacy Policy. We will also retain and use your data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

6. Your Data Protection Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • Right to Access: You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
  • Right to Rectification: You have the right to request correction of any information you believe is inaccurate or completion of information you believe is incomplete.
  • Right to Erasure: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data under certain conditions.
  • Right to Restrict Processing: You have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data under certain conditions.
  • Right to Object to Processing: You have the right to object to processing of your personal data under certain conditions.
  • Right to Data Portability: You have the right to request transfer of the data we have collected to another organization or directly to you under certain conditions.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at: info@onda-life.com

7. Children's Privacy

Our App is not intended for use by persons under 13 years of age ("Children"). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from children without verification of parental consent, we will take steps to remove that information from our servers.

8. Analytics & How We Use the Emotional Check-In Tool

When you use our HRV tools and the emotional check-in (Emoton), we collect anonymous, aggregated usage analytics to understand how the tools are used and improve them. This includes which steps you reach and which options you select.

We use PostHog (hosted in the US) for this. We do not build a personal profile of you: analytics run in an anonymized mode with no automatic data capture and no identity linking. Your emotional inputs are recorded only in aggregate and are never tied to your identity.

If you select responses indicating acute distress, that interaction is deliberately excluded from analytics entirely — it is never recorded as an event.

We also use Reddit Pixel and Google Analytics to measure how people arrive at our site from ads and links. These do not receive your emotional inputs.

You can opt out of analytics at any time via your browser's Do Not Track / privacy settings, or by contacting us through the contact page.

8.1. Anonymized Aggregated Health Analytics & Research (Mobile App)

To understand how ONDA is used and to improve it — and, in the future, to publish general insights about health and breathing (for example, "how much HRV typically changes after a night of drinking") — we collect anonymized, aggregated analytics through Google Analytics for Firebase. These analytics are never linked to your identity and cannot be used to identify you. They include:

  • How you use the app: which practices you start and complete, which screens you view, whether features work as intended.
  • Anonymized, aggregated health signals: the size of a deviation from your personal baseline, whether a practice changed your pulse or HRV, your baseline resting heart rate, HRV and respiratory rate and how much they vary day to day, and your typical sleep duration and timing — always as coarse, non-identifying values (averages, ranges or bands), never raw data tied to you.
  • A 10-year age band (for example, "30–39"), read once from Apple Health if you have entered your date of birth. We store only the band — never your exact date of birth or age.

We use this data in aggregate only — combined across many users. Any published insight is a statistical aggregate across many people; it never contains or reveals any individual's data, and figures are drawn only from users with a connected Apple Watch. Some of these measurements may be derived from your Apple Health history, read on your device when you connect — not only from live events. Your health data itself — heart rate, HRV, breathing rate, sleep, and the baseline built from them — is read from Apple Health and processed on your device; it is not sent to our servers.

8.2. Age and Minors (Research)

ONDA is intended for adults. Users identified as under 20 are excluded from all research aggregates and any published insights. We do not knowingly build products for, or collect research data from, minors. This is in addition to the children's-privacy commitment in Section 7.

8.3. Legal Basis, Consent and Opt-Out (Health Analytics)

Anonymized health-related analytics are a special category of data under Article 9 of the GDPR. We process them on the basis of your explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a) GDPR), given when you connect Apple Health — where the app discloses this collection with a link to this policy. You can withdraw consent at any time: turn off "Share anonymous analytics" in the app's Settings, which stops this collection entirely, and you can revoke Apple Health access at any time in iOS Settings → Privacy → Health. We never sell your data, we never link health measurements to your name, email or identity, and we never collect reproductive-health data, medical diagnoses, medications, clinical records, or precise location for these analytics.

9. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page. We will also notify you via email and/or a prominent notice in our App before the change takes effect and update the "Effective Date" at the top of this Privacy Policy.

You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

10. Contact Information

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: info@onda-life.com
